subject: E-4244: database locked on macOS
body:
Sofia Rossi -- Brightwater Clinics. Appreciate any pointers.

I've already tried searching the help centre, which changed nothing.

Our backup job runs nightly exactly when I sign in for the day. Waiting ten minutes and opening it again makes it work.

Hello support team. We run PixelForge 6.0.5 on macOS 14.7. Starting Tuesday, the moment I open the app a dialog reads "E-4244: local database is locked".
